reviews.comment: Dr Achorn is the best! She's such a kind person, but beyond that she really wants to see her students succeed. It's not so much about curveballs but helping students interact with the materials so they learn. I learned way more from her homeworks that I ever would have just memorizing and regurgitating. I wish I could take her again
Good lectures and one of the hot professors.

Professor Achorn is AMAZING. She is the sweetest and most understanding professor I've had. She is very flexible with due dates and gives great feedback on papers. We had to write 3 one-two page responses, with the rest being extra credit, and 2 major papers along with 3 tests. Textbook not required and everything u need to know is in lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Most amazing teacher! Smart, sweet, funny, & always available to answer questions. Although there is a lot of homework & in class work, Angie will answer all your questions and help you through it. She provided test review sessions & homework that corresponds to test. Really helps people learn the material. Take the lecture section & lab together!

I went to her exam review that she held on a not class day and its insane how many fossils she knows. By looking at a skull she could say the name, date and location which I thought was crazy but by the end of the 2hours I was able to too somehow so she is definitely a good teacher. Often teachers are knowledgeable or their caring, but she is both.

Freaking adorable!! Not in a patronizing way, just that she loves the material and loves teaching about it and it shows each class. Also downright hilarious! Beyond helpful in class and in labs. Downside is she talks very rapidly but I think she knows she does so if you just ask her to slow down or repeat something she will listen. Hi angie!!!!
